messages:
Ibrahim: Quick personal update — accepted the Staff ML Eng role! Also Mina surprised me and proposed over the weekend ❤️. Wedding likely in September. Wanted to share with everyone :tada:
Mina: AAAAAAHHHH!!! So proud!! :sob: Love you!!
Connor: Promo + engaged? Plot twist. Congrats both 🥳. When's the ring inspection scheduled? :eyes:
Priya: Bring on the rooftop celebration :sparkles: I’ll make a playlist.
Tess (People Ops): Huge congrats!! :tada: We can arrange a little celebration at the office. @Ibrahim DM me preferred dates and any PTO you plan to take.
Ibrahim: Thanks! I’ll DM. Planning a short week in Sept for planning/honeymoon. No parental leave in sight :grin:
Connor: Cake poll time — vote with emoji: croissant cake 🥐, chocolate fudge 🍫, lemon tart 🍋
Mina: 🍫 all the way.
Ibrahim: 🍋 but I’ll happily accept 🍫 too. Also, low-key expecting celebratory code review comments :stuck_out_tongue:
calendar-bot: Event created by Mina: "Team celebration — Ibrahim promo & engagement" on 2026-04-02 16:30 PT
Priya: Adding confetti GIF and a tiny celebratory Slack reaction :confetti_ball:
Connor: Mandatory ring inspection before guest list finalization. Also who’s in charge of sparklers? :sparkler:
Tess (People Ops): I’ll coordinate card and gift collection channel. We’ll also make sure a cake option is ordered for remote folks (shipping cookies?).
Ibrahim: Appreciate everyone. Back to triaging, but couldn’t not share the good news :)
